title: Local plugins
boundary: Inspect installed local packages without running their commands. Imported plugins stay disabled until you enable them in Plugins. Project-scoped or incompatible contributions need review.
empty: No local plugin entries were returned. Check the source status below.
confirmApply: Install {{name}} as a disabled plugin? Source files stay unchanged; commands, Hooks and MCP servers are not started.
confirmUndo: Remove only this operation’s unchanged installation of {{name}}? User changes and live version leases block removal. The audit and captured package are retained.
review: This entry needs review before it can be imported.
environment: The package declares additional runtime requirements. Importing it does not configure or validate those dependencies.
unknown: The operation outcome needs checking. Refresh the original record before retrying.
batch: This operation is managed by a batch. Continue from the batch record.

errors.migration_plugins_update_required: Update the selected target to a version supporting local plugin migration.
errors.plugin_migration_user_policy_changed: The user policy changed. The installation was kept; review its settings before undoing.
errors.plugin_migration_target_changed: The installed package changed. It was kept to protect those changes.
errors.plugin_migration_in_use: A running session uses this version. Close that session before undoing.
errors.plugin_migration_private_state_not_copie: The package contains private state such as OAuth credentials. Remove it from the migration selection and prepare a clean package.
errors.plugin_migration_source_changed: The selected source changed. Prepare a new reviewed plan.
errors.plugin_migration_stale_sequence: The operation changed. Refresh its original record.
errors.plugin_migration_claimed_by_another_owne: A batch owns this operation. Continue from its batch record.
errors.plugin_migration_pending_resolution_requ: This entry needs scope or compatibility review. Resume cannot bypass that review.

batchBoundary: Prepare static packages and add them to one migration batch for shared preview and confirmation. This picker does not install or enable them.

project.include: Include plugins from the trusted source workspace
project.map: Map project/local plugins to this trusted target workspace; keep disabled

transfer.uploaded: Inspect only packages in these user-supplied files. Recorded source paths are not opened. Project/local packages require a separate target workspace mapping and stay disabled.
transfer.boundary: Transfer only the selected static plugin package. Source enablement, credentials and registry state do not grant target permissions. Install remains disabled until a separate normal batch confirmation.
transfer.partial: I reviewed the discovery issues and choose only these available packages.
transfer.updateRequired: Update both targets to transfer plugin packages.
transfer.failed: The original plugin catalog could not be confirmed.
